about:
Mitchell Plastics operates from Huntsville, Alabama. The business traces its roots to Ultra Manufacturing Ltd., which began in Waterloo, Ontario producing injection-moulded components. No founding year or original founders are disclosed in public records.

The company designs, engineers, and manufactures precision components for automotive interiors. Its capabilities span full-service design, hydrographics, applique, in-mould coating, prototype and production moulds, in-mould assembly tools, and automated robotic assembly. An on-site Innovation Centre demonstrates hydrographics and applique techniques. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Mitchell Plastics serves the automotive interior sector, supplying components to vehicle manufacturers and tier suppliers. Concrete customer names are not disclosed.

The firm emphasizes a sustainability mindset, reporting that since 2012 multiple solar arrays have generated roughly 730,000 kWh per year, and in 2018 two lithium-ion battery banks were installed to reduce peak power draw. The company also highlights a balance of creativity and engineering through its "Innovation Inside" philosophy.
